fact_text: The analyst says PIA will be held under PIA Holding, which will list under a different symbol, so the delisting is not a reason for panic since the privatisation runs through that holding.

fact_text: The analyst expects PIA's price to stay weak for some time, with the new listing opening at the market price that prevails at the time of the closing.
